140802498.source_assessment: Cached difference-image deficit peaks at the target pixel; target/deficit distance 1.864 arcsec. The deficit centre is closer to the target than the flux-capable catalogued neighbours; own-pixel losses include mixed source light and are supporting spatial diagnostics only. Centroid displacements are descriptive, without calibrated uncertainty; G/TESS band differences, uncatalogued blends and PSF modelling limit the test. Lead inspected the cached three-panel image. A bounded repeatability test of the cached sector 97 cutout places seven-event half-stack deficits 3.12/0.77 arcsec from the target versus 12.06/11.36 arcsec from the capable neighbour. Individual event deficits stay nearer the target. Shifted empirical out-of-eclipse template fractional residual is 0.159 at the target versus 0.494 at the neighbour; the template is blended and this is a diagnostic, not a formal PRF likelihood. These repeated spatial comparisons identify the target as the source to the available TESS resolution. The shared rounded pixel and mixed own-pixel flux alone were not used as exclusion evidence.
